title: Fixed components, flexible time
statement: Keep every component in every lesson and vary only its time, by lesson type and learner, with floors: support shrinks but never vanishes, and retrieval keeps about a tenth.
example: Retrieval never falls below about 10% of a lesson, and at least one quick check comes before students write alone.
detail: A Grade 9 lesson design specification fixes the components and lets their time change: every lesson contains every component, each lesson row takes a timing profile, and the time is then adjusted by stage and by results. Its floors keep retrieval at about a tenth of the lesson or more, at least one quick check before students write alone, and a close however short. Stage 1 students get more guided practice in the same lesson and Stage 3 students move to independent practice sooner; if students struggled in independent practice last lesson, the next lesson's guided practice expands, and a quick check at its start lets confident students move straight on. Guided practice can be fast-tracked but never removed.
against: How a learner reaches a stage is still undecided in the specification (`othello-archive/sources/Year 9 ELA- Lesson Design Specification for Devfactory.txt`, line 510). Expanding the next lesson's guided practice on one lesson's results can mean adapting on fewer observations than the three another engine requires (Never adapt on one observation), and nothing here measured the floors or the adjustments. The same Grade 3 design removes the earlier modelled steps once a procedure is known, keeping only the step that models the write-up (`g9/sources/Readventure - Lesson Design and Scaffolding - Updated.docx`, line 285). A unit's first lesson has nothing earlier to retrieve: one draft said "because this is the first lesson, there is no retrieval practice." (`g9/sources/meeting-notes/ELA - CNU + Academics - 2026_10_01 20_30 IST - Notes by Gemini.md`, line 272), though the later video sheet gives the first lesson a retrieval, a word web on the unit's key concept (`g9/sources/Othello Unit Video_ Info Sheet for Devfactory.md`, line 48).
